name: SparkFun Electronics
old_description: Since 2003, SparkFun has been helping turn ideas into reality – whether you’re creating a smart weather station, exploring the frontier of machine learning, building a robot for school or prototyping your first (or tenth) product. No matter your vision or skill level, our open source components, resources and online tutorials are designed to broaden access to innovative technology and make the road to a finished project shorter.
about:
SparkFun Electronics was founded in 2003 in Niwot, Colorado. The company began with a mission to make electronics accessible to engineers, hobbyists, and educators through open-source components, tutorials, and documentation.

The company designs and manufactures a wide range of open-source hardware, including sensors, microcontroller development boards, and kits, while also distributing third-party components from brands such as Raspberry Pi, Teensy, and NVIDIA. A dedicated subsidiary, SparkPNT, focuses on high-precision positioning, navigation, and timing products built to be durable, future-proof, and repairable. SparkFun operates with approximately 140 employees and offers a custom kit assembly service for educational workshops and classroom curricula.

SparkFun serves engineers, prototypers, hobbyists, product developers, and educators across industries such as education, robotics, Internet of Things (IoT), environmental monitoring, positioning/navigation/timing (PNT), and artificial intelligence/machine learning. Concrete examples from its partner network include AI robots running on NVIDIA Jetson modules, high-precision GPS boards using u-blox technology, DIY heart-rate monitors, and community hackathons.

The company emphasizes open-source hardware and accessible documentation to lower barriers to emerging technology. Its products are designed to be durable, future-proof, and repairable, and it provides a solderless Qwiic modular ecosystem to simplify prototyping. SparkFun also offers volume pricing, a distributor/reseller program, and free domestic shipping on most orders over $100.

Spartan Auto & Heavy Truck Parts operates from Inman, South Carolina, where it has served the automotive and heavy-truck aftermarket for over two decades. The company traces its roots to a focus on restoration-grade components, though no founding year or original owners are publicly disclosed.

The business stocks more than 100,000 individual part numbers covering automobiles and heavy trucks, ranging from OEM replacements to used components. Spartan differentiates itself with a price-match guarantee, negotiable pricing, and a commitment to ship orders to the lower 48 states within one to five days. name: Specialized Switchgear Solutions LLC
old_description: , we specialize in the design, manufacturing, and service of high-quality switchgear solutions. From custom builds to maintenance and retrofits, we deliver reliable power distribution systems that keep your business running safely and efficiently.
about:
Specialized Switchgear Solutions operates from Mansfield, Ohio. The company was formed by Rick Knox and Donald Smith after the February 2020 closure of PACS Switchgear, where both had spent decades advancing through production, quality, and management roles. Knox, a Six Sigma Blackbelt, had overseen manufacturing operations with up to 400 employees, while Smith led special projects, field service, and parts management. Their combined experience spans assembly, design, quality assurance, and customer support across medium‑voltage switchgear.

The firm designs, manufactures, and services custom switchgear assemblies, including circuit breakers, switches, potential transformer drawers, and ground‑and‑test devices. It handles new builds, maintenance programs, and retrofits for power distribution systems, backed by a team of engineers, technicians, and project specialists. Quality assurance follows tested protocols, and lean manufacturing principles guide production, though facility size and headcount are not disclosed.

Customers include industrial and commercial facilities that require reliable medium‑voltage power distribution. The company’s work covers custom component fabrication, spare‑parts supply, and on‑site field service for installation and maintenance. No specific end‑user sectors are named beyond the switchgear industry itself.

The founders emphasize safety‑first engineering to the highest industry standards, precision manufacturing with verified quality checks, and a service commitment that extends beyond delivery. The venture was launched to continue the switchgear expertise they built at PACS and to maintain long‑term client relationships after that company’s shutdown.

name: Specialty Plastics Inc.
old_description: Specialty Plastics Inc. is a custom plastic injection molder located in St. Peters, MO. Our core competency is tight tolerance plastic parts. For over 40 years, we have supplied high quality injection molded products and services to a wide array of business: medical instruments, automotive, healthcare, home appliances, sporting goods, electrical and many more. Injection molding is our specialty.
about:
Specialty Plastics Inc. operates from St. Peters, Missouri, where it was started in 1980 as a full‑service injection molder. The company has spent more than four decades supplying tight‑tolerance plastic parts to a broad range of businesses, building its reputation on a partnership‑first philosophy that ties its growth directly to customer success.

The shop specializes in custom plastic injection molding and extends its capabilities to blow molding, thermoset molding, insert molding, and over molding. An in‑house tool and mold shop handles tooling design, CAD‑based prototype development, and production tooling. Secondary operations include hot stamping, pad printing, laser marking, sonic welding, milling, drilling, assembly, and special packaging. Twenty‑one molding machines are networked to a central computer for real‑time process tracking, and the plant runs 24 hours a day, five days a week.

The customer base spans medical instruments, automotive, healthcare, home appliances, sporting goods, electrical, electronics, industrial equipment, motor manufacturing, toys, and leisure equipment. Clients range from OEMs requiring high‑precision components to companies leveraging just‑in‑time and kanban inventory programs for daily delivery to local facilities.

Specialty Plastics differentiates itself through accessible management — no layered bureaucracy — and a stated commitment to flexible supply‑chain solutions. Its quality system is ISO 9001 certified, supported by a CMM, optical comparator, and automated Keyence inspection. The company emphasizes a standard two‑week lead time, with daily kanban shipments for nearby customers, and a willingness to handle orders of any size.

Speed & Engine Warehouse traces its roots to 1920, when Car Parts Machine opened in downtown El Paso, Texas, offering precision engine machining and parts. The business later adopted the Speed & Engine Warehouse name and expanded to a second location in Tucson, Arizona, where its headquarters now reside. The company remains a family-operated enterprise serving the Southwest from both storefronts.

Today the firm operates as a distributor of aftermarket and OEM replacement parts, stocking engine kits and components for a wide range of passenger-car and industrial engines — from Detroit Diesel to Honda. Its two locations carry inventory across categories that include engines and components, chassis, brakes, suspension, steering, drivetrain, ignition, cooling, and safety equipment, representing hundreds of performance and replacement brands.

The customer base spans automotive repair shops, engine builders, racing teams, fleet operators, and DIY enthusiasts throughout the El Paso and Tucson regions and beyond. Industries served include automotive aftermarket, motorsports and performance, heavy-duty diesel, and general industrial engine maintenance.

The company was founded to provide local machine-shop expertise and quality engine parts, a mission that evolved into a broad parts-distribution model while retaining the original focus on engine-related products.

The company emphasizes reliability, transparency, and efficiency in every step of the procurement process, offering competitive pricing through global sourcing and custom solutions tailored to exact specifications.

name: Spotted Owl Timber Inc.
old_description: Spotted Owl Timber, Inc. is located in Santa Fe, NM. We are a locally owned sawmill that was founded in 1991 by David Lindsey. David is a third generation sawmill owner and operator. He was born in New Mexico and grew up in the logging and sawmill industry. David opened Spotted Owl in 1991 with a small Woodmizer band mill and cut beams and lumber for the growing demand of southwestern style homes in Santa Fe and around Northern New Mexico.
about:
Spotted Owl Timber, Inc. is a locally owned sawmill in Santa Fe, New Mexico, founded in 1991 by David Lindsey. Lindsey, a third-generation sawmill operator born and raised in New Mexico, started the business with a small Wood-Mizer band mill to supply beams and lumber for the growing demand for southwestern-style homes in Santa Fe and northern New Mexico.

The company manufactures natural, custom wood products from locally harvested softwood species including Ponderosa pine, white fir, Douglas fir, and Engelmann spruce. Operations center on a thin-kerf band mill that the company says yields up to 30 percent more lumber per log than traditional circular sawmills, with no chemicals added. The facility has expanded to include a larger Wood-Mizer band mill and additional equipment, though specific facility size, headcount, and production volumes are not disclosed.

Customers include contractors, private homebuilders, and the general public throughout northern New Mexico. The mill serves residential construction and remodeling projects seeking southwestern-style timber and lumber.

The business emphasizes sustainable harvesting by local independent loggers, natural materials without chemical treatment, and the efficiency of its thin-kerf band mill technology.
